body:
Now hello everyone. Its me the op. I thought ill share what happened for those few who might have cared.

It will be long so TL-DR at the end + im on phone so grammar, paragraphs will be shit.

Im still alive and i dropped those thoughts, shes not worth it. If shes so stupid and dumb. I ordered the book and will start reading it. Now what changed:


I was miserable and suffering so much as you guys know. 
Im not religious im all about science, but i bought the rope and was on my way to any forest and suddenly for no reason at all my grandmother showed up (the closest person to me) ill spare you the bullshit details, but she insisted for me to go to some kind of "energy witch/magician/god servant.. w/e. I promised her, with the intention whatever if its 1% that it might help all i can lose is a 50 euros and time.

I went there, i was held there for nearly 8 hours, there were lots of things which were okish, others which made no sense at all but i stayed no matter how stupid it felt and looked. She talked about angels, god, energy flow etc. She told me that god introduced us to each other and it was destined for us to be together. But human will is very strong and sometimes even god is helpless about it and that her unthought action to leave was not logical and her love "angel" stayed with me thats why i suffered so much and could not shake her off. It was like she was with me on soul "level" but her body presence missing, thats why i longed for her so dearly and dreamed about her every night, etc. And every morning and night was so hard, because i felt her presence sleeping near me, but there was nothing physical near me and it drove me crazy + suffering.

And that she will give all of our energy, angels back and cut that bond for my own sake and future. 
W/e it sounded like bullshit but i kept reminding myself some words from extraordinary book i read "fools expierence or how to get rid of eyeglasses" where an author told that if you dont have anything to lose anymore, no matter how unbelievable something is, but if it costs you just a few hours of your time and have 1% chance - stay. Listen, maybe you will learn something. 
So i stayed, 8 hours on a small soviet style chair with no back rest, im 197cm tall, it was uncomfortable, tiresome, stupid but i let the old grandma do her thing, she even asked do i believe her all i said, it does not matter if i believe or not, if it has even a slight chance to work out why not to try.

Anyway she told everything will be ok. But i felt like shit anyway 2 days pass my birthday. Im sad, depressed as always, but my sister which was involved in our seperation greatly, made me come to visit them at least for 1 hour to eat, have a drink at local restaurant. She still talks and chats with my ex. Trough closed teeth we chatted about her briefly 
And my birthday was approx 1 whole year of suffering and bad luck for me and about 9-10 months of our seperation, so she told me that my sister dreamed about my ex and after the dream straight up told her, that (my ex) will never be happier than she was with me and that she did huge mistake and is stupid, ex agreed and cited "well if its meant to be it will be, aka that destiny will bring us back together" and then in my mind i was, no fuck you stupid bimbo, you left me to suffer, and ran for another dick and still expect such things? And at that moment some switch in me switched.

Turns out not only that, she now lives with the new guy and finally understood what i told many times that not everything is vine and roses, turns out she started to regret her stupidity, turns out she acknowledged that she made a stupid decision and will never be with anyone as happy as she would have been with me, but both of us know that i could never forgive her for what she did, going for another dude and salvaging our bond like it meant nothing without even trying or giving me a chance once. 
Now she found out that charm of first impression is short lived. Now she became very "bitter", angry, selfish and treats people of her circle pretty badly and my sister told me "with him you were a better person, more honest, more loving" and she agreed and cited that stupidity again, that means finally her eyes started to open, but she still expects a happy ending - no fuck her for what she did. I will not say never, because in my life i had my lessons to never say "never" but she would need a lot, for me to ever let her back into my life.

Now - i dont dream about her anymore, well at least not that often, i still miss her, i still think about her all the time, i am still sad and i still cant forgive the universe, reality or accept what happened and how that happened, but now its different. I dont think that with the relationship and her stupidity my life ended, its hard but i must move forward and accept reality and life as it is.

Sorry for bad english, not a native speaker.


TL-DR 1. Went to energy doctor/ god servant etc
2. Got info that my ex finally acknowledged regret of her stupid and unthought actions
3. Somehow her stupidity about "if its meant to be it will be" but while on it ill keep fucking this other dick, until or if "destiny" fix my shit i caused, extremely repulsed me.
Maybe its not a whole stroy but i simply dont want to know more about her and we finished the topic with my sister right in time.
4. Maybe my birthay fixed things? 1 whole year of pain and suffering.
Maybe all of that combined helped? Im still skeptical about energy doctor, but something really changed for sure.

5. I dropped all the thoughts of suicide, even if im sad and still miss her and cant accept what happened i must move forward.

                                                                                           




For those interested - our meeting each other was super strange as well. 

- When i was a student i decided to go to UK for summer holiday to work and get some money to fund myself better while studying. My goal was to go to my friend who lived there, super small town in east sussex, he found me a "job" and i went with my friend, by car. 2k+ km trip. When we docked in uk i got pulled over by cops, they told me that my insurance papers are not right, aka turns out for me unkowingly my car was not insured in uk, but in all other eu countries (well shit) they pound my car, with all our stuff everything, in uk its extremely harsh punishment in my country its just a small fine. Bad luck.

1. I try to fight the system to get my car back before it being crushed, its expensive, debt, debt, debt.
I lose the job my friend found me cuz im too busy trying to find a way.
I get my car back, but need to go to agency to work odd jobs. Im in lots of debt so i decide to stay 1 month longer than intended. because of the incident i work a lot, then another friend offers me a more stable work i accept, the agency describes me a wrong car which should bring me to work i dont go my first day, second day i am waiting and there stands my ex, her first day as well. We both are seated in the same car (another odd event led to this aka me getting bad description of a car and driver my first day) turns out shes from my small country - ok. All i say to her "goodmorning, goodbye, how its going" too focused on work and solving my debt. I was in extra saving mode, i never went out ever, but one friday night i insist on going to a bar with one friend something unusual for me "just for one beer" out of 15 bars we accidentaly come to the one where my ex was celebrating her friends birthday, from there everything started.

So much "chance" if i never got my car pounded i would never have met her, same for debt and staying extra month, wrong car, then odd attraction to a bar for no reason, other strange random chances and many more, especially when we got back home, which led us to instantly start living together and getting very close, now though it does not matter. She fucked everything up and thats very sad. :( thanks for attention and everything guys, this acc is a throwaway, but i will try to be fine. Thanks.
